nodes.name: Zendesk Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes: Zendesk event webhooks (zen:event-type:ticket.*) or trigger webhooks (JSON template in README). 6 pinned fictional deliveries.

nodes.name: Intercom Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes: Intercom conversation and ticket topics. 5 pinned fictional deliveries.

nodes.name: Reconcile Poll
nodes.notes: Every 30 min: catches updates a webhook missed. Pinned fictional poll.

nodes.name: Verify & Unwrap Support Event
nodes.notes: Zendesk base64 HMAC-SHA256(ts+body) · Intercom sha1 HMAC (client secret) · topic filters.

nodes.name: Package Poll Results
nodes.notes: Same envelope as the webhooks · advances cursors (live only).

nodes.name: Ticket Normalizer & Sentiment Evaluator
nodes.notes: 5 shapes → unified ticket · resolution minutes · CSAT · sentiment · batch merge · ledger.

nodes.name: Fetch Zendesk Requester
nodes.notes: Event webhooks carry requester_id only · e-mail + name kept.

nodes.name: Plan HubSpot Ticket
nodes.notes: Create (with associations 16/26) or update · stage & priority maps · stale guard.

nodes.name: Write HubSpot Ticket
nodes.notes: batch/create (new, with associations) or batch/update (existing) · creates aren't auto-retried.

nodes.name: Group Tickets by Account
nodes.notes: Ticket items pass through · one rollup item per company.

nodes.name: Search Company Tickets
nodes.notes: All synced tickets on the company (both platforms), newest 100.

nodes.name: Compute Account Health
nodes.notes: Open · urgent · resolution · CSAT · sentiment grade · health score/status.

nodes.name: Audit Logger
nodes.notes: IDs, statuses, timings, scores · never subjects or message text.

nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires when this workflow is selected as its own Error Workflow.

parameters.content:
## n8n-zendesk-intercom-hubspot-unified-ticket-health-sync
Zendesk + Intercom → unified tickets → HubSpot tickets → company health properties. dhRobin Systems.

**Safe defaults:** `SANDBOX_MODE=true`, `DRY_RUN=true`. No Zendesk, Intercom or HubSpot calls until both are `false`.

**Stage 1** Execute each trigger (Zendesk, Intercom, Reconcile Poll) with its pinned fictional data.
**Stage 2** `SANDBOX_MODE=false`: real lookups, writes simulated.
**Stage 3** `DRY_RUN=false`: tickets and account health go live.

Conversation text is never copied to HubSpot or the logs.

### Account health rollup
Every synced ticket on the company (both platforms) → open/urgent counts, resolution, CSAT, sentiment grade, health score.

### Sanitized error path
No stack traces, headers or bodies. Tokens, client secrets and webhook URLs are redacted.
